summary: Review #2 of CC-0005 B002: All 8 issues from review #1 (1 blocking V3, 6 major, 1 minor) have been fully resolved. The deprecated client.Apply usage was replaced with a new applyconfig/ package providing ToApplyConfiguration() and DefaultFieldManager. Parameter ordering in secrets/ was standardized. EnsureDatabaseUser was decomposed into ensureUser/ensureGrant helpers. Simulator duplication was eliminated via simulateConditionsOnlyReady. Integration tests now use per-test GenerateName namespaces throughout. Missing assertions (issuerRef fields, idempotent User+Grant survival) were added. The implementation delivers 7 Kubernetes-client packages (config extension, secrets, database, deployment, job, tls, policy extension) plus 2 new simulators, a shared applyconfig utility, and a testutil.CreateTestNamespace helper. golangci-lint reports 0 issues. go vet passes. All unit tests pass. Integration tests compile correctly (envtest binaries unavailable in review environment).

issues_found.description: Package doc.go carries (CC-0004) but was extended with CreateImmutableConfigMap in CC-0005. Consider updating to (CC-0004, CC-0005) for traceability.
issues_found.fix: Update doc comment to: '// Package config provides pure functions for building and merging OpenStack INI configuration files, and Kubernetes-client helpers for creating immutable ConfigMaps. (CC-0004, CC-0005)'

issues_found.description: Package doc.go carries (CC-0004) but was extended with LoadPolicyFromConfigMap in CC-0005. Consider updating to (CC-0004, CC-0005) for traceability.
issues_found.fix: Update doc comment to include (CC-0005) alongside existing (CC-0004).

issues_found.description: The applyconfig/ package (DefaultFieldManager constant, ToApplyConfiguration function) is not documented in the reference docs. It's an internal utility consumed by deployment/ and job/ packages.
issues_found.fix: Add an applyconfig section documenting DefaultFieldManager and ToApplyConfiguration.

issues_found.description: Parameter 'database' in EnsureDatabaseUser shadows the enclosing package name. No functional impact today but reduces IDE clarity and could cause confusion if qualified function calls are added later.
issues_found.fix: Rename parameter to 'databaseName' to match the EnsureDatabase parameter naming convention at line 31.

issues_found.description: hashData uses 'key=value\n' format for SHA-256 input. A key containing '=' or a value containing '\n' could theoretically produce hash collisions between distinct data maps. Practically near-impossible with valid Kubernetes ConfigMap keys, but length-prefixed encoding would be more robust.
issues_found.fix: Consider 'fmt.Fprintf(h, "%d:%s=%d:%s\n", len(k), k, len(data[k]), data[k])' for theoretical collision safety.

issues_found.description: Uses inline namespace creation with manual t.Cleanup instead of the shared testutil.CreateTestNamespace helper used by all other integration test files. Functionally equivalent but inconsistent.
issues_found.fix: Replace manual namespace creation with testutil.CreateTestNamespace(t, ctx, k8sClient, "test-policy-") and add the testutil import.
